question: Select the misspelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"iminent"** is misspelt. The correct spelling should be **"imminent"**. (आसन्न)

 
 
• **Example: **The dark clouds indicated that a storm was ***imminent.***
 
 
 
• **"Imminent"** refers to something that is about to happen very soon. (आसन्न)
 
 
• **Example: **The arrival of the train is ***imminent***, so we should hurry to the platform.
 
 

Hence, the correct spelling should be **"imminent"**.

.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Temperament** (स्वभाव): The nature or habitual disposition of a person.

 
 
• **Example:** Her calm* **temperament*** makes her an excellent leader.
 
 
 
• **Reticent** (मितभाषी): Not revealing one's thoughts or feelings readily.
 
 
• **Example:** He was ***reticent ***about his plans for the future.
 
 
 
• **Pertinent** (प्रासंगिक): Relevant or applicable to a particular matter.
 
 
• **Example:** Her comments during the meeting were very*** pertinent*** to the topic at hand.
